title: Geometry
description: An abstract collection built around geometric forms, including shapes, lines, patterns, and structured compositions. The designs range from minimal, symmetrical layouts to more complex arrangements, with a focus on color, contrast, and repetition.

geometry-000001.title: Geometric Sunset
geometry-000001.description: An abstract geometric composition featuring a glowing sunset partially obscured by dark vertical forms, with deep blue, red, orange, and teal tones creating a minimal atmospheric scene.
